scope: Independent read-only review of the standalone dense overlap builder, its owning test, and the D3 skill/pattern routes. No canonical file was changed by the reviewer.
sourceConclusions: The grow helper writes actual final radius attributes immediately, so portable circles and dots do not depend on transient CSS or browser animation state.
The embedded generated layout retains original region, task, label-face and leader coordinates and source task memberships.
Only declared semantic regions use fill-opacity 0.28. Opaque task dots and explicit local label backings retain borderless colorset paint and exact maximum-contrast black/white labels.
Replay uses root opacity animation only; reduced motion bypasses that animation. Geometry remains final before and after Replay.
The standalone builder extends the canvas with a separate caption rail without moving source task, label, leader or region coordinates.

All required inputs, renderer excerpts, templates, palette data and vendor runtime are inside the D3 bundle. Generated outputs are rejected inside the read-only skill resource. Documented root IDs and canonical pattern IDs match the builder.

Published gallery, shared solid-style runtime, colorset adapter, SVG exporter and shared renderer helper files have no diff from the accepted source. The added standalone caption rail does not modify the published fixture.

resolvedTestFinding.problem: Viewport-only captures could omit standalone mobile SVG sample points beyond 390 pixels.
resolvedTestFinding.resolution: The owning test captures the complete standalone SVG locator and subtracts that element's bounding-box origin. Mobile HTML keeps its centered scrolling frame and visible candidate filter.

independentManualDeliveryReview.finding: Both palette deliveries visibly preserve the dense set/task arrangement, shared membership intersections and opaque task labels. The footer and legend occupy a clear separate rail below all task labels.

limits: This review verifies the supported generated nine-region/100-task layout, finite reported states, and the source paths named above. It does not claim arbitrary custom labels or every possible viewport are collision-free. The published fixture's inherited footer/T095-caption contact remains separately disclosed in prior publication evidence; the new standalone builder clears it through its caption rail.
